FX-MERCURY-001.says: As added: twenty drops a second from the middle, thrown every way at half the picture's height a second and falling, each 1.6 pixels across the radius here, swelling in and shrinking out over its two seconds; the picture replaced by them. At frame 0 none is born and the layer is clear.

FX-MERCURY-002.says: A close look: about six drops a second, 5 pixels across the radius, lit from the top left; frame 6 one young drop, frame 24 several running together.

FX-MERCURY-003.says: Animation Direction, Direction 90, Extra 0: every drop thrown to the right at one speed, falling.

FX-MERCURY-004.says: Animation Direction, Direction 90, Extra 100: thrown to the right in a fan 90 degrees wide, at speeds from none to full.

FX-MERCURY-005.says: Animation Twirl, no gravity: the drops thrown round the producer like a pinwheel.

FX-MERCURY-006.says: Animation Vortex, no gravity: the drops spiralling out round the producer.

FX-MERCURY-007.says: Animation Fixed: the drops stay where they are born, swelling and shrinking.

FX-MERCURY-009.says: Resistance 300: the drops slow and hang closer to the producer.

FX-MERCURY-010.says: Blob Influence 0: hard discs over each other, not running together.

FX-MERCURY-011.says: Blob Influence 300: the drops reach far and run into one puddle.

FX-MERCURY-012.says: Influence Map In: drops swell in and never shrink out.

FX-MERCURY-013.says: Influence Map Out: drops born at full size, shrinking out.

FX-MERCURY-014.says: Influence Map Constant: no swelling or shrinking but from the birth size to the death size.

FX-MERCURY-015.says: Birth Size 0, Death Size 400: drops born as points, growing to 6.4 pixels across the radius.

FX-MERCURY-016.says: Longevity 0: no drop lives, the layer clear.

FX-MERCURY-017.says: Birth Rate 0: no drops, the layer clear.

FX-MERCURY-018.says: The picture with its right half clear, the producer as wide as the picture: drops are born only on the left half.

FX-MERCURY-019.says: Birth Rate keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 24 at frame 12: by frame 11 five drops have been born, the rate summed from the in point.

FX-MERCURY-020.says: The producer keyed from 20 per cent across at frame 0 to 80 at frame 24, no gravity or speed: the drops left in a trail behind it.

FX-MERCURY-021.says: FX-MERCURY-002 moved 3 pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-MERCURY-022.says: FX-MERCURY-002 with the layer starting at frame 6: frame 12 is 002's frame 6 and frame 30 its 24.

FX-MERCURY-023.says: An orange point light near the top left, 10 pixels up, Metal 0: white-ish drops lit orange on the side facing it.

FX-MERCURY-024.says: Unlit: each drop the picture's colour where it was born, flat.

FX-MERCURY-025.says: FX-MERCURY-002 at 30 frames a second: frame 24 is four fifths of a second in, not one.

FX-MERCURY-026.says: Animation Direction, the direction keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 180 at frame 12, no gravity: the drops born early still go up, the late ones down.
